name: surface-view-path-place-composition
description: A view sends a composition placement while a place that leaves the view out runs, and the page answers the call with null without sending the placement to the host.
reason: The view calls reach the page as the notice view-call of a view that the host runs in a window, which the Go producer does not run (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).
